nc.description: A grey, pointed mechanical arm is chipping pieces off a rounded object suspended above a smooth cylinder resting on a plate.
A smooth, grey, ribbed cylindrical shaft connects to a jointed, cross-shaped structure next to a separate ring.
A group of light gray geometric shapes is piled together against a white background.
A white, geometric object resembling a stylized bow tie with a fragmented right side hovers above a smooth cylindrical base against a plain background.
A white, angled object with a circular joint is centered within a symmetrical arrangement of smaller grey geometric shapes on a white surface.

vc.description: A textured grey arm holds a circular lid slightly above a white cylindrical container.
A grey mechanical assembly features a threaded shaft passing through a circular flange with small, textured attachments, alongside a detached threaded ring.
A mechanical assembly features a central interlocking hinge connected by metal arms to two rectangular pads with textured tops and cushioned bottoms.
An exploded view of a mechanical assembly shows an articulated arm with a textured pad, a central fluted component, and a cross-sectioned housing aligned horizontally.
A mechanical hand tool is centered within a radial arrangement of identical brackets, bolts, and washers on a white background.
